name: catastro-gps-mcp
description: Cadastral parcels from 29 European countries (31 official cadastres, including the Basque Country and Navarre): reference, coordinates, address in 27 countries, Spanish dwellings, geometry, terrain, climate, ground motion, solar, agriculture, market, score and comparison.
long_description: One API key for official cadastral data from 29 European countries, 31 official cadastres including the Basque Country and Navarre (Germany: 15 of 16 Lander, not Bavaria; Portugal: not Lisbon, Porto or Coimbra; Croatia through ARKOD and Sweden through agricultural parcels; Scotland by coordinates). Look up parcels by reference or coordinates, turn a postal address into ranked parcels in Spain and 26 more countries, list every dwelling of a Spanish building, get parcel outlines as GeoJSON, read relief, protected areas, ERA5-Land climate normals and satellite ground motion (EGMS), estimate solar and agricultural potential, read aggregated market prices (France, Italy, Germany), score and compare parcels, and follow how a parcel changes over time. Every result carries your remaining monthly quota and prepaid balance. Free tier: 250 calls per month, and failed lookups are not charged.
